notes.title: 2.2 : Quest Reset !
notes.content:
2.2.1 : Quest Reset : Players need to Repeat the Intro quest as we have introduced a breaking change to the Quest data format. This allows us quite a bit more scope for what we can do with quests.

Quest Data and Relic will be deleted but all Equipment + Experience , Cubitz etc. will be retained.

Simply repeat the intro quest which hopefully runs smoother now with a bit more Information included in popups.
